prompt.numbers: Put the tiles in the empty boxes so every row and column is true.
prompt.signs: Choose a sign for each empty box so every row and column is true.
prompt.both: Fill the empty boxes with numbers and signs so every row and column is true.

right.title: Every line is true!
right.message: Every row and every column works.

message.one: {count} box is not right. It is marked. Tap it to take it back.
message.other: {count} boxes are not right. They are marked. Tap one to take it back.

hint.oneGap: {line} has only one empty box. Start there.
hint.findLine: Look for a row or column with only one empty box.
hint.tryOne: Try a tile in {line}, then check that the line is true.
hint.workedNumber: {line} says {equation}. Which number makes it true?
hint.workedSign: {line} says {equation}. Try each sign in the box until it is true.
